editorialReview.reviewNote: Independent English localization locked to the Korean Source Lock; role, timing, conditions, exceptions, numbers, and service boundaries preserved.

marketing.targetReader: Cosmetics responsible sellers preparing a Korean OEM launch
marketing.readerQuestion: Can a finished product be sold immediately?
marketing.practicalPayoff: Separate the two reporting deadlines and the documents to reconcile
marketing.coverIntent: A finished production run does not equal launch readiness
marketing.saveValue: A checklist for matching final documents before shipment
ctaInputs: Selling product name and package proof
ctaOutcomes: A preliminary review of mismatched product and ingredient details
marketing.performanceHypothesis: Test whether deadline comparison and document-reconciliation cards are saved

cards.headline:
OEM production is complete.
Can you sell yet?
body: For Korean OEM cosmetics, check the responsible seller’s ingredient-list report before launch.
cards.takeaway: As a rule, report the ingredient list before distribution or sale.
cards.oneMessage: As a rule, report the ingredient list before distribution or sale.
cards.design: A cosmetic container and final ingredient document line drawing; one clear question
cards.promise: The reporting deadline and document-matching test

cards.headline:
The factory makes it.
The responsible seller reports it.

body.text: Provides final ingredient data and cooperates with the report.
The seller distributing or selling the product on its own responsibility is the legal reporting party.

cards.takeaway: Article 5(5) of the Cosmetics Act: outsourcing production does not remove the duty.
cards.oneMessage: Article 5(5) of the Cosmetics Act: outsourcing production does not remove the duty.
cards.design: Contrast the two roles; give visual weight to the responsible seller.

cards.headline:
The two reports
have different deadlines.

body.text: For a new product, report the manufacturing ingredients before distribution or sale.
Report the previous year’s production by the end of February of the following year; this is not sales performance.

cards.takeaway: Article 13 of the Enforcement Rule: keep the two deadlines separate.
cards.oneMessage: Article 13 of the Enforcement Rule: keep the two deadlines separate.

sourceTrace.heading: ‘내년 2월 말까지 보고하면 된다’는 말은 무슨 뜻일까요?

cards.design: A vertical timeline contrasting before sale with the end of February.

cards.headline:
A different ingredient name—
did the formula change?

body.text: Check whether the same ingredient is named differently or a blend lists its ingredients differently.
If a fragrance changed after sampling, match the manufacturer’s final data—not the old description.

cards.takeaway: Do not decide from the name alone. Confirm what production actually used.
cards.oneMessage: Do not decide from the name alone. Confirm what production actually used.

sourceTrace.heading: 첫 샘플과 마지막 생산품, 같은 보습크림이 맞을까요?

cards.design: A magnifying-glass line drawing leading to two possible explanations.

cards.headline:
Can you copy the full-ingredient
label into the report?

body.text: The consumer-facing label has its own standards and some ingredient exceptions.
A separate duty: identify the product and format its manufacturing ingredients to the association’s input standard.

cards.takeaway: A package label does not contain every detail needed for the report.
cards.oneMessage: A package label does not contain every detail needed for the report.

sourceTrace.heading: 전성분 표시안을 그대로 붙여 넣으면 되는 걸까요?

cards.design: Contrast the package panel with the reporting document.

cards.headline:
The product name
continues into the next report.

body.text: Manufacturer information matches the final ingredient data.
It refers to the same product as the selling name.
The name is consistent in both reports.

cards.takeaway: The Association’s February 25, 2022 example shows that inconsistent product names can require correction.
cards.oneMessage: The Association’s February 25, 2022 example shows that inconsistent product names can require correction.

sourceTrace.heading: 공장의 제품명과 판매 제품명이 다르면 어떻게 할까요?

cards.design: A document-reconciliation table with the selling name highlighted.
head: Items to compare
What to confirm

cards.headline:
You reported it once.
Is the next production covered?

body.text: For a new product, confirm the ingredient-list report before sale.
A changed list must also be reported before sale.
A new lot number alone proves no change; compare the report with actual manufacturing.

cards.takeaway: If product details or the manufacturer changes, check the change rules.
cards.oneMessage: If product details or the manufacturer changes, check the change rules.

sourceTrace.heading: 원료목록은 한 번 보고하면 계속 쓸 수 있을까요?

cards.design: Three vertical branches: initial, change, repeat.

cards.headline:
A completed report
is not a safety approval.
body: Quality testing and functional-cosmetics review or filing must be checked separately.
cards.takeaway: An ingredient-list report is not prior safety approval.
cards.oneMessage: An ingredient-list report is not prior safety approval.

sourceTrace.heading: 전성분 표시안을 그대로 붙여 넣으면 되는 걸까요?

cards.design: A large shield line drawing separates reporting from safety approval.

cards.headline:
Before distribution or sale,
match these documents.
body: Confirm final ingredient data match the product you will sell.
Compare the selling name, package proof, and any previous report.
Confirm submission and the report result, not just screen entry.
cards.takeaway: Do not use the first order date alone; confirm the actual distribution or sale point.
cards.oneMessage: Do not use the first order date alone; confirm the actual distribution or sale point.

sourceTrace.heading: 생산은 끝났는데, 보고는 언제까지 해야 할까요?

cards.design: Three document checks connected as a saveable checklist.

cards.headline:
What you can prepare
and where document work begins

body.text: When final data and product details match, the responsible seller may file under the association system’s guidance.
Report-document drafting and legally permitted filing are agreed separately by scope and fee.

cards.takeaway: Send final ingredient data, selling name, and package proof for a free preliminary review of mismatches.
cards.oneMessage: Send final ingredient data, selling name, and package proof for a free preliminary review of mismatches.

sourceTrace.heading: 출고 전에 세 문서를 나란히 놓아보세요

cards.design: Separate direct preparation from paid document work; emphasize only the final review CTA.
